critique: In colour and grayscale the large gold Cast is the lightest, heaviest control and the eye lands on it first; Get out is smaller and darker, the HUD panels are mid-grey. Cast leads at least as clearly as Level up on the pass anchor.

Gold fill only on the main action (Cast), gold rim and name only on the chosen crew member; green only for health; school markers carry a shape as well as a colour; Get out is a neutral plum, not a misused red; every control stands off the dark ground in grayscale.

The headline timer '2:25' is flat dark figures on a cream plate with no ink outline, hard drop or gradient fill: the fail anchor's treatment, not the pass anchor's inked, embossed figure. The crew names and 'Laws here' over the world show no clear outline at 200% either.

Cast is the only light, saturated gold block and clearly outranks the same-size dark Get out; the larger Room/Left panel is dark and informational, the 2:25 timer about half Cast's size, so Cast leads at least as clearly as on the pass anchor.
